We vacate and remand for further proceedOPINION AND ORDER Plaintiff, West Michigan Film LLC (WMF), brought this action alleging that defendants James W. Metz II and Donovan Motley tortiously interfered with a business relationship or expectancy between WMF and the State of Michigan. texts.full_text: for Investigative Reporting sued the Oakland Police Department on Thursday, alleging it violated the state's public records law by refusing to release documents related to a federal review of the department's handling of gun violence. The nonprofit news organization asked for the records in March, seeking information about the federal probe, which was launched after the department was criticized for not adequately investigating shootings and homicides. However, the police department has not provided any of the requested documents, leading to the lawsuit. "The Oakland Police Department has a well-documented history of mishandling gun violence investigations," said the Center for Investigative Reporting's executive director, Lance Williams. texts.full_text: ependencies can optionally be included in the same capsule. An XML file named manifest.xml is automatically created and included in the capsule. This file contains the entire list of repositories contained within the capsule and the order in which they must be imported into a Tool Shed. This file also includes information about each repository (e.g.,the repository owner and revision) as well as the Tool Shed categories associated with each of them. The Tool Shed into which the capsule is imported will be inspected to see if any of the contained repositories already exists. Those that do will not be overwritten or altered in any way. A repository created in a Tool Shed from an imported capsule will be defined as installable only if its creation resulted in no errors. Since repositories that were exported into a capsule are associated with a user (the owner), the user importing the capsule into a Tool Shed must be authorized to create the repository in that Tool Shed with that specific owner. If the current user is an admin user or is a member of the Tool Shed’s Intergalactic Utilities Commission, all repositories will be created no matter the owner. Otherwise, only repositories whose associated owner is the current user will be created. Rate repository This feature
